description.en: Author-maintained distribution index for DSH Pretty Cool. Not an official DSH catalog.
description.zh: DSH Pretty Cool 作者维护的分发索引，非 DSH 官方目录。

description.en: A compact prompt-centered layout with native token/context statistics, one-click thinking levels, flat navigation and warm light/dark surfaces. Native sessions, editor, tools and permissions stay connected. Disable the whole bundle to restore the original interface.
description.zh: 以 prompt 为中心的紧凑布局：原生 token/上下文统计收进输入面板，单击循环切换思考级别，搭配平面导航和暖色明暗主题。保留原生会话、编辑器、工具与权限；停用整个整合包即可恢复原界面。
